# HoMyDash! — app information

> An iPhone dashcam app in development by Marco Massari Calderone, United Kingdom.

The product is in development. No release date, store availability, certified
hardware matrix or implemented modular purchase catalogue is announced here.
The planned first release focuses on manual recording, saving, reviewing and
exporting, with one video source at a time. Ray-Ban support depends on verified
compatibility and authorised Meta availability. The app privacy notice is still
in preparation. Website content must not be treated as a complete privacy policy.

## English

- [Product](https://homydash.marcomc.com/): Product scope and development status.
- [Support](https://homydash.marcomc.com/support/): Recording guidance and contact.
- [Privacy status](https://homydash.marcomc.com/privacy/): Notice in preparation.

Each language has /support/ and /privacy/ below its home URL.
Public contact: <marco@marcomc.com>. Callback /meta is a neutral fallback and does
not confirm authentication. The site does not process callback codes.
